name: Potion of Invisibility

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Invisible for 1 hour, or until you attack, deal damage or cast a spell.
text: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink it, you have the Invisible condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.
